user.title: Add a Cololight
user.description: These lamps answered on your network. Choose one, or enter an IP address manually.

data_description.device: Lamps that are already configured are not listed.

manual.title: Enter the IP address
manual.description: No new lamp was found automatically, or you chose to enter its address. The lamp must be powered and connected to your Wi-Fi.

data_description.host: Address of the lamp on your local network, for example 192.168.0.51. A fixed address (DHCP reservation in your router) is recommended.

device.title: Choose the model
device.description: Cololight found at {host} (MAC {mac}). The model sets the list of available effects.

data_description.model: The lamp cannot report its model over the local network: choose it here.

discovery_confirm.title: Cololight discovered
discovery_confirm.description: A Cololight was found at {host} (MAC {mac}). Choose its model to add it.

data_description.model: The model sets the list of available effects.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the Cololight
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the model of this lamp.

data_description.host: Address of the lamp on your local network.
data_description.model: The model sets the list of available effects.

error.cannot_connect: No Cololight answered at this address. Check the address, and that the lamp is powered and connected to your Wi-Fi.

abort.already_in_progress: This lamp is already being set up.
abort.not_cololight: This device is not a Cololight: it does not answer the local protocol.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Another lamp answered at this address. To add a new lamp, use "Add device" instead.

data.save_as_default: Save the state as power-on state automatically

data_description.scan_interval: How often the state of the lamp is read, in seconds. Changes made with the Cololight app show up after at most this delay.
data_description.save_as_default: Once the state has stopped changing, store it in the lamp's memory so that it comes back after a power cut. The memory wears out with writes: it is written once per change, never on every slider move.
data_description.save_delay: How long, in seconds, the state must stay unchanged before it is saved.
data_description.hidden_effects: Built-in effects to remove from the effect list of the light.

add_custom_effect.title: Add a custom effect
add_custom_effect.description: The effect joins the effect list of the light, like in the Cololight app. Mode: 1 to {modes} for this model.

data_description.name: Name shown in the effect list. An existing custom effect with the same name is replaced.
data_description.scheme_color: Family of the effect and its colour.
data_description.mode: Animation pattern, numbered as in the Cololight app.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name. It cannot be "off" or "Unknown palette effect", or start with "Effect ".
error.invalid_custom_effect: This combination is not valid for this model.

abort.no_custom_effects: There is no custom effect to remove.

save_state.name: Save as power-on state
save_state.description: Stores the current colour or effect and brightness in the lamp's memory, so that it starts with them after a power cut. The memory wears out with writes: do not call this very often.

set_custom_effect.name: Set custom effect
set_custom_effect.description: Starts a custom effect built like in the Cololight app: colour scheme, colour, speed and animation mode.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Colour of the scheme, written as in the app: for example "Red", "Rainbow" or "Red, Green, Blue" for Breath, "Birthday" for Scene.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Animation pattern: 1 to 13 on the strip, 1 to 27 on the hexagon.

set_effect_code.name: Send effect code
set_effect_code.description: Sends raw effect frames to the lamp (advanced). The code of the running effect is shown in the effect_code attribute of the light.

code.name: Code
code.description: One or more frames of 8 hexadecimal digits, separated by spaces or commas, for example "049a0000". A frame cannot start with 00.

communication_error.message: The Cololight at {host} did not answer. Check that it is powered and connected to your Wi-Fi, then try again.

command_rejected.message: The lamp rejected the command (error code {code}).

unknown_effect.message: Unknown effect: {effect}. Effect names are case-sensitive: write the name exactly as in the effect list.

no_adjustable_speed.message: The current effect has no adjustable speed.

unknown_custom_color.message: Invalid custom effect: "{color}" is not a colour of the {scheme} scheme. Its colours, written exactly like this (case-sensitive): {colors}.

custom_mode_out_of_range.message: Invalid custom effect: the mode must be between 1 and {max} on this model.

no_effect_frame.message: Invalid effect code: give at least one frame of 8 hexadecimal digits, for example "049a0000".

invalid_effect_frame.message: Invalid effect code: "{frame}" is not a frame of 8 hexadecimal digits.

effect_frame_is_colour.message: Invalid effect code: "{frame}" starts with 00, which selects a static colour. Use rgb_color to set a colour.

cannot_save_unknown_palette.message: The running palette effect is not identified, so it cannot be stored as power-on state. Start it again by its name from Home Assistant, then save.
